Ingestion: EU object storage with Kafka upload events
Preprocessing: OCR, content-hash deduplication, text stored beside source
Classification: approved EU-region LLM with a prompt covering 60 claim types, definitions, and ten examples; returns confidence
Inference batching: batches of 20 small documents
Worker scaling: 4 to 120 Kubernetes workers scaled by Kafka backlog
Result traceability: store prompt version and model name with each result
Result delivery: second Kafka topic with independent consumer groups per team; analytics warehouse hourly
Human review: confidence below 0.7 enters labeling queue; claims staff correct type
Feedback loop: monthly prompt-example refresh from corrections, checked on 2,000 reviewed documents before switching
Quality monitoring: per-type review share and mean confidence dashboard, alert on review-share doubling week over week; weekly random sample of 300
